baseline_record.why: The routine composes a matrix from texture-object scaling, rotation, translation, repetition, and mirror-wrapping configuration, directly implementing texture-coordinate transformation.

links.reason: Requires nonzero repeats. XY scale factors are repeat/scale except abs(scale)<1e-10 selects zero; Z scale is copied. Uses rotation XYZ with negated Z as Euler input, negates X/Y translation, adds mirror-T correction computed with its own division, copies Z translation, and composes scale*rotation*translation. The near-zero scale guards do not guard the mirror correction division.
